question: 自建图定位失败发生在哪一层：地图表示、落点误差，还是滤波器失稳？

protocol.fixed: same patrol scans, collection route, init and seeds (ISO/ANISO x worlds 0-2 x sensors 0-1); only PF particle budget differs between the two input benchmarks
protocol.decomposition: representation gap = truth-projection minus ideal (same landing); landing gap = self-built minus truth-projection (same scans); computed on episodes whose ideal-map arm did not diverge (mean<=1 m)

headline.conclusion: landing error dominates; map representation is not the bottleneck; particle count is not the lever; filter instability is a separate failure mode

next_single_variable: likelihood field sigma / measurement update gating with particles and map fixed; if still no improvement, switch to divergence detection + reseeding instead of further tuning
